summary: Defines a framework for grouping the media lines (m lines) of a Session Description Protocol (SDP) description, using the group and mid attributes. It shows two uses: lip synchronization of audio and video, and receiving one media flow made of several streams on different transport addresses. It is a Proposed Standard and replaced RFC 3388.

eli5.summary: A video call has sound and picture. This gives each part a name tag and lets you say which parts belong together, like matching a voice to the moving lips.
